papers.date: Submitted 5 June, 1997; v1 submitted 12 November, 1996; originally announced November 1996.
papers.abstract: We present a theory for disordered interacting electrons that can describe both the Mott and the Anderson transition in the respective limits of zero disorder and zero interaction.
